columns.text: Proportion of sick pay etc. out of net income, percent
columns.comment:
The numerator consists of the sum of sick pay, sickness and activity allowance, unemployment benefit, income support, introductory allowance and foothold allowance. The denominator consists of net income (the sum of all taxable and tax-free income minus taxes and other negative transfer payments). Age bracket 20–64 years. Due to non-response in the collection of income support data for 2011 and onwards, “Proportion of sick pay, sickness and activity allowance, etc. out of net income” for the country and county is only based on the municipalities that submitted complete income support data. As of 2009, unemployment benefit includes activity support and development allowance in addition to unemployment benefit paid out of an unemployment insurance fund. 
  
Source: [Income and tax statistics](https://www.scb.se/HE0110-EN) 
  
Source: [STATIV database](http://www.scb.se/stativ)

columns.text: Proportion of income support out of net income, percent
columns.comment:
The numerator consists of aggregated income support. The denominator consists of net income (the sum of all taxable and tax-free income minus taxes and other negative transfer payments). Age bracket 20–64 years. Due to non-response in the collection of income support data for 2011 and onwards, “Proportion of income support out of net income” for the country and county is only based on the municipalities that submitted complete income support data. For further details please see the website of the National Board of Health and Welfare.

Source: [STATIV database](http://www.scb.se/stativ)

columns.text: Proportion of introductory allowance out of net income, percent
columns.comment:
The numerator consists of aggregated introductory allowance. The denominator consists of net income (the sum of all taxable and tax-free income minus taxes and other negative transfer payments). Age bracket 20–64 years. A municipality may grant introductory allowance to refugees and certain other immigrants who have been received in a municipality as part of the municipal refugee reception process. The municipality determines the size of the introductory allowance. Not all municipalities use the possibility of granting introductory allowance to refugees. This is the case for around 50 municipalities in 2007. In some municipalities, introductory allowance is included in income support. 
  
As of 2012, introductory allowance is no longer included in the the National Board of Health and Welfare’s collection for financial assistance statistics, even though disbursements may continue for as long as introduction lasts. 
  
Source: [Income and tax statistics](https://www.scb.se/HE0110-EN) 
  
Source: [STATIV database](http://www.scb.se/stativ)
